scripts.build: vite build && npm run build:jury && npm run copy:jury
scripts.copy:jury: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; import path from 'node:path'; const src=path.join('formular-jurat','dist'); const dest=path.join('dist','formular-jurat'); fs.mkdirSync(dest,{recursive:true}); fs.cpSync(src,dest,{recursive:true});"
